data.title: Weather — Starter · Lesson 1
data.subject: weather
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Alright now, let's dive in.

[Hook]
Coffee and clouds… Café y nubes
Here we go… Aquí vamos
Rain or shine… Lluvia o sol
This moment's ours… Este momento es nuestro

[Verse]
The sun is shining… El sol brilla
Windows wide open wide.
A cool day… Un día fresco
Just you and me, side by side.
Good vibes… Buenas vibras
We feel it in the air.
The wind is blowing… El viento sopla
Whispering everywhere.

[Hook]
Coffee and clouds… Café y nubes
Here we go… Aquí vamos
Rain or shine… Lluvia o sol
This moment's ours… Este momento es nuestro

[Verse]
White clouds… Nubes blancas
Floating in the sky.
The bright moon… La luna clara
Lights up the night on high.
A starry night… Una noche estrellada
Full of dreams to share.
The blue sky… El cielo azul
Reminds us that we care.

[Bridge]
Rain is falling… La lluvia cae
But we're warm inside.
Listening to the rhythm… Escuchando el ritmo
Of the world outside.
Thankful for this day… Agradecidos por este día
With every sip and smile.
